feature.title: Feature toggles
feature.description: Platform agent tools let models in conversations read the user's files/skills/conversation history and edit user data. Disabled by default on fresh installs; read tools and write tools are controlled separately.

runtime.title: Runtime parameters
runtime.description: Parameters for write operations and file re-processing.

enabled.label: Enable platform agent tools
enabled.description: Exposes read-only tools to the model: list_files / read_file / read_skill_file / list_skills / list_conversations / read_conversation.

writeEnabled.label: Enable write operations
writeEnabled.description: Exposes write tools (write_file / update_skill). Actual execution is also gated by each user's write approval mode (auto / ask).

fileReindexDelaySeconds.label: Re-index buffer (seconds)
fileReindexDelaySeconds.description: Delay before text extraction / RAG rebuild after a file is modified. Rapid successive modifications are merged into a single rebuild.

toast.loadFailed: Failed to load platform agent tools settings
toast.saveFailed: Failed to save platform agent tools settings
